new.x: Under the Treaty of Seringapatam, Tipu gave up half his territory, paid Rs 3 crore and handed over two sons as hostages to the British, Marathas and Nizam, who were allied against him. new.s: Which one of the following statements about the Regulating Act of 1773 is NOT correct?

It abolished the Court of Directors of the Company.
It required the Court of Directors to report on revenue, civil and military affairs to the British Government.

new.x: The Act did not abolish the Court of Directors (APPSC-GS 2019 'incorrect statement'). Instead it made the Directors report to the British Government on revenue, civil and military affairs.
